# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::filter_bar`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

A search box with a clear button over the bare field chrome (`widget.filter-bar`): an inset
surface with a 14 px search icon at the left, a [`FieldChrome::Bare`](field.md#variant.FieldChrome.Bare) field, and an 18 px clear
[`icon_button`](../ui.md#method.Ui.icon_button) at the right while the text is non-empty. There is no ring: the
caret is the only focus cue.

The field's id is the bar's, so [`FieldResponse::response`](field.md#structfield.FieldResponse.response) names the field; the clear button is
the child `"clear"` of it. The button registers after the field to come after it in the Tab
order, so a clear lands after the field drew: the frame reports `changed`, and the frame the
input asks for after it (D81) shows the empty field and no button.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/filter_bar.rs:1`

**Fields**

- <a id="structfield.FilterOptions.placeholder"></a>`pub placeholder: &'a str`

  Shown while the text is empty; the accessible name when there is no `label`.

- <a id="structfield.FilterOptions.label"></a>`pub label: Option<&'a str>`

  The accessible name.

- <a id="structfield.FilterOptions.clear_unfocusable"></a>`pub clear_unfocusable: bool`

  The clear button takes no focus and is no tab stop, so focus stays in the field: for a
  composite whose keys go through the field. The pointer and accessibility still reach it.
